_about: Modstoke Loader text, English. This is the source language: every other file translates these keys. Text in {braces} is filled in by the Loader and must stay as written.

about.normal: The game as it was made to be played: survive, build and find out what happened on the island.
about.hardSurvival: Hard, with harsher survival: less food to find, slower recovery and colder nights.
about.peaceful: No enemies. Explore and build at your own pace.
about.creative: Build freely with every item to hand and no need to eat, drink or rest.
about.custom: Set each rule yourself on the next page.

games.chooseMode: Choose how you want to play.
games.startFailed: That could not be started. The Loader log says why.

options.title: Options
options.none: Nothing to change here on this PC.

resolution.name: Resolution
resolution.about: The size of the picture in pixels. Your monitor's own resolution gives the sharpest image.

windowMode.name: Window mode
windowMode.about: Whether the game fills the screen or runs in a window.

vsync.name: Vertical sync
vsync.about: Matches each frame to your monitor's refresh, which stops tearing. It can add a little delay to your input.

maxFps.name: Frame rate limit
maxFps.about: The most frames per second the game draws. A limit keeps your PC cooler and quieter; Max removes it.

gamma.name: Gamma
gamma.about: Brightens or darkens the middle tones of the picture.

brightness.name: Brightness
brightness.about: Raises or lowers the brightness of the whole picture.

dlss.name: NVIDIA DLSS
dlss.about: Draws the game at a lower resolution and rebuilds a sharp picture from it, for more frames per second. Needs an NVIDIA RTX graphics card.

fsr3.name: AMD FSR 3
fsr3.about: Upscaling that raises the frame rate by drawing fewer pixels. Works on most graphics cards.

dynamicResolution.name: Dynamic resolution
dynamicResolution.about: Lets the game lower its drawing resolution in busy moments to keep the frame rate steady.

resolutionTarget.name: Resolution target
resolutionTarget.about: The share of the screen's resolution the game aims to draw at when dynamic resolution or upscaling is on.

qualityPreset.name: Quality preset
qualityPreset.about: Sets every graphics option at once. Each one can still be changed afterwards.

drawDistance.name: Draw distance
drawDistance.about: How far away the world is drawn in full detail.

textures.name: Texture resolution
textures.about: The detail of surfaces. Lower it if your graphics card runs short of memory.

grass.name: Grass
grass.about: How much grass is drawn and how far it reaches.

billboards.name: Distant trees
billboards.about: The quality of the simplified trees drawn far away.

terrainDetail.name: Ground detail
terrainDetail.about: How finely the shape of the ground is drawn close to you.

terrainDepth.name: Ground depth
terrainDepth.about: How far out the ground keeps its sense of depth and texture.

terrainFiltering.name: Ground filtering
terrainFiltering.about: Keeps the ground sharp when you see it at a shallow angle.

filtering.name: Texture filtering
filtering.about: Keeps surfaces sharp when you see them at a shallow angle.

shadows.name: Shadows
shadows.about: How sharp shadows are and how far they reach. One of the most demanding options.

ambientOcclusion.name: Ambient occlusion
ambientOcclusion.about: Soft shade where surfaces meet, which gives the world depth.

contactShadows.name: Contact shadows
contactShadows.about: Small, sharp shadows where things touch the ground.

microShadows.name: Micro shadows
microShadows.about: Fine shadow in the small details of surfaces.

reflections.name: Screen-space reflections
reflections.about: Reflections of what is on screen in water and wet surfaces.

fog.name: Fog
fog.about: The quality of fog and of light passing through it.

clouds.name: Clouds
clouds.about: How the clouds in the sky are drawn.

water.name: Water quality
water.about: The quality of lakes, rivers and the sea.

waterWaves.name: Water movement
waterWaves.about: Lets the surface of the water rise and fall with waves.

antiAliasing.name: Anti-aliasing
antiAliasing.about: Smooths jagged edges. TAA gives the smoothest result; SMAA and FXAA cost less.

motionBlur.name: Motion blur
motionBlur.about: Blurs the picture during fast movement.

chromaticAberration.name: Chromatic aberration
chromaticAberration.about: Color fringes toward the edges of the picture, as a camera lens makes.

filmGrain.name: Film grain
filmGrain.about: A fine grain over the picture, like film.

colorGrade.name: Color style
colorGrade.about: The overall color style of the picture.

gameLanguage.name: Game language
gameLanguage.about: The language of the game's text. Modstoke's menus follow it unless a language is chosen on the Modstoke tab.

subtitles.name: Subtitles
subtitles.about: Shows what is said as text on screen.

fov.name: Field of view
fov.about: Widens or narrows how much of the world you see.

hud.name: On-screen display
hud.about: Shows or hides everything drawn over the game while you play.

hudScale.name: Display size
hudScale.about: The size of what is drawn over the game while you play.

vitals.name: Vitals
vitals.about: Shows your health, hunger, thirst and energy.

minimap.name: Mini map
minimap.about: Shows the small map in the corner of the screen.

interaction.name: Interaction prompts
interaction.about: Shows the prompts for what you can pick up and use.

building.name: Building guides
building.about: Shows the guides and prompts while you build.

tutorials.name: Tips
tutorials.about: Shows tips while you learn the game.

reticle.name: Aiming mark
reticle.about: Shows where a bow or gun is aimed.

nameTags.name: Player names
nameTags.about: Shows other players' names above them.

treeRegrowth.name: Tree regrowth
treeRegrowth.about: Lets cut trees grow back over time.

structureDamage.name: Structure damage
structureDamage.about: Lets what you build be damaged.

skipBuildAnimations.name: Skip building animations
skipBuildAnimations.about: Places building pieces without their animation: never, in creative mode only, or always.

bigHeads.name: Big heads
bigHeads.about: A joke setting that makes heads much bigger.

mouseX.name: Mouse speed, sideways
mouseX.about: How fast the view turns as you move the mouse left and right.

mouseY.name: Mouse speed, up and down
mouseY.about: How fast the view turns as you move the mouse up and down.

invertY.name: Invert looking up and down
invertY.about: Pushing the mouse or stick up looks down.

aimX.name: Aiming speed, sideways
aimX.about: How fast the view turns sideways while you aim a ranged weapon.

aimY.name: Aiming speed, up and down
aimY.about: How fast the view turns up and down while you aim a ranged weapon.

padX.name: Stick speed, sideways
padX.about: How fast the view turns left and right with the controller's stick.

padY.name: Stick speed, up and down
padY.about: How fast the view turns up and down with the controller's stick.

deadzone.name: Stick dead zone
deadzone.about: How far a stick must move before it counts. Raise it if the view drifts by itself.

crouchToggle.name: Crouch toggle
crouchToggle.about: One press crouches and the next stands, instead of holding the button.

sprintToggle.name: Sprint toggle
sprintToggle.about: One press starts sprinting, instead of holding the button.

inventorySpeed.name: Inventory cursor speed
inventorySpeed.about: How fast the cursor moves over your inventory with a controller.

bindings.name: Keys and buttons
bindings.about: Change which keys and buttons do what. This opens the game's own controls screen for now.

effects.name: Sound effects
effects.about: The volume of the world and everything in it.

voices.name: Voices
voices.about: The volume of spoken lines and voice chat.

dynamicRange.name: Dynamic range
dynamicRange.about: How far apart quiet and loud sounds are kept. A narrower range suits small speakers or playing at night.

voiceCount.name: Sound channels
voiceCount.about: How many sounds can play at once. Lower it if the sound stutters.

proximityChat.name: Voice chat
proximityChat.about: How your microphone works in multiplayer: push to talk, or always on.

menus.name: Menus
menus.about: Modstoke's menus, or the game's own as they were. To come back, set classicMenus = false in Modstoke/UserData/openacai-loader.settings.cfg.

textLanguage.name: Modstoke language
textLanguage.about: The language of Modstoke's own text, such as these menus. Following the game uses the game's language.

empty.filtered: No servers match your search and filters.

notice.otherVersion: This server runs another version of Sons of the Forest.
notice.hosted: Hosted games don't list their mods yet; a Modstoke host checks them when you join.
notice.checking: Asking it which mods it runs.
notice.modded: It doesn't list its mods. It may run another loader or an older Modstoke.
notice.vanilla: This server runs no Modstoke, so mods with their own items won't work there.
notice.match: You can join with the mods you have.
notice.addsItems: This server has no mods with their own items, so yours won't exist there.
notice.refused: Its mods with their own items differ from yours.
